text.en:
The municipality of Surabay shall begin to exist upon thb
appointment and qualification of the Mayor, Vice-Mayor
and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and sixty-five.
By the President:
SALVADOR L. MARINO
DroSDADO MACAP AGAL
